visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women with long dark hair are seated at a white table in a brightly lit indoor home setting. The woman on the left wears a white fluffy knit top, while the woman on the right wears a grey patterned turtleneck and holds a grey tablet. They both look directly at the camera with neutral but friendly expressions. (2) A variety-show style graphic overlay appears with purple and white text, momentarily covering the center of the screen. (3) The scene returns to the two women. The woman on the left now holds a smartphone while the woman on the right operates the tablet. They engage in a discussion, looking at each other and then back at their devices. (4) A digital interface overlay representing a quiz or poll appears, showing questions in Traditional Chinese with circular radio buttons for options. (5) The woman on the left points towards the camera or tablet while speaking, displaying expressive facial movements and mouth-opening gestures. (6) Various quiz questions are sequentially displayed as on-screen graphics, alternating between the full-screen quiz interface and the two women reacting to the questions. (7) Towards the end, large text overlays appear above their heads showing numerical scores. They react with laughter, clapping, and wide smiles before the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice introducing the topic in a friendly, conversational tone. A bright, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM plays consistently in the background at a moderate volume. (2) A second female voice joins, creating a dynamic dialogue. There are frequent short, clean vocal pauses as they transition between speaking. (3) A soft 'ding' sound effect marks the appearance of the first quiz graphic. The voices discuss the options, with their pitch rising during moments of surprise or laughter. (4) The BGM continues smoothly as the dialogue remains high-density, focusing on reading and reacting to various personality questions. (5) There is a noticeable increase in vocal volume and laughter toward the end. The final phase concludes with the two women laughing synchronously and the sound of light clapping, with the music fading out quickly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Question List -> Discussion -> Results
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain viewers by following a popular personality test trend (Thinking vs. Feeling personality types). The creators use their contrasting reactions to hypothetical social scenarios to showcase their different MBTI traits, engaging the audience through humor and relatable social dilemmas.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high amount of on-screen text to guide the viewer through the quiz, making it highly suitable for social media consumption without audio, though the audio provides significant emotional cues.
